g.text: I'm curious about something. But I don't know if you'd be willing to talk about it.
Oh, come on. I think it's cute.
Ask. If I don't want to talk, I won't.
I have a name already. And a lot of things are cuter than that.
What was it like, growing up with Eleanor?
What brought you here? To Höllvania?
You with a five 'o clock shadow. ;)
Okay, okay. I'll let it drop.
What made you want to be a soldier?
How'd you get that skana of yours?
I'd... really rather not get into that.
Was there something you wanted to talk about?
It's a long story. And it's not that I don't trust you, right?
Longer answer another time? Over drinks, maybe?
We've been through some strange things together.
There's just a difference between fighting beside somebody...
Fine, you can use it. Just...keep it between us, all right?
No, I get it. Maybe another time, then? After I buy you a few rounds first?
